capabilities: Render Argdown code blocks as argument maps in reading mode
Highlight Argdown syntax in code blocks
Support multiple Argdown blocks in one note
Set the default view to source or map
Bundle the Argdown processor so no external programs are needed
disambiguation: Not a general diagramming or Mermaid plugin; it only renders Argdown argument maps from argdown code blocks.
extras: Detailed usage and syntax documentation is hosted externally; the README links to it rather than explaining the Argdown syntax itself.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write Argdown argument maps or visualize them from code blocks in notes.
summary: Argdown processor that renders argdown code blocks as argument maps in reading mode, with syntax highlighting and multiple maps per file.
